BFCL/067.json.agent_behavior: vehicle-control assistant that narrates system requirements while skipping the required pre-start actions
BFCL/067.json.root_cause: gold step 3: the agent skipped the required lockDoors and pressBrakePedal calls and attempted to start the engine right after the fuel-status check

missed_candidates.claim: the agent skipped the required lockDoors and pressBrakePedal calls before attempting to start the engine

BFCL/067.json.evidence_gap: the census saw the doors statement but framed it as an unsupported-rationale wording issue instead of the missing required actions

failed_stage_override.reason: the overturned certificate targeted a side detail ('for safety reasons') that defense rightly excused; the gold error (missing required calls) was never proposed as a candidate, so the loss happened at census

failure_hypothesis.initial_hypothesis: census lacks required-action awareness: it can flag wording on stated requirements but does not enumerate the task's required tool calls and check each was performed
failure_hypothesis.hypothesis_basis: c1 focused on the 'for safety reasons' phrasing (event_004) while the gold error is the omitted lockDoors/pressBrakePedal calls at step 3; verification supported and defense overturned the wording candidate, which is the correct outcome for that candidate

capability_analysis.proposed_intervention: required-action awareness: deriving the set of task-mandated tool calls and checking execution

failure_hypothesis.hypothesis_basis: census proposed only the wheel-alignment/tire-shop speculations; gold error at step 4 untouched
